s: A system for systematically measuring, testing, and monitoring the quality, accuracy, safety, and performance of AI models and LLM-powered applications in production.
w: Evaluation services run test suites against LLM outputs to measure quality dimensions: correctness (factual accuracy against ground truth), relevance (how well output addresses the prompt), safety (toxicity, bias, policy compliance), faithfulness (RAG responses grounded in source documents), and latency/cost metrics. Evaluations can be automated (LLM-as-judge, rubric scoring) or human-in-the-loop. The service maintains evaluation datasets, runs regression tests on model changes, and produces dashboards tracking quality over time with alerts on degradation.
use: Pre-deployment validation of model changes or prompt updates
Continuous monitoring of production LLM output quality
A/B testing comparing two model versions or prompt strategies
avoid: One-off evaluations without ongoing monitoring (quality drifts silently)
Using only automated metrics without human evaluation for subjective quality
Evaluating every production request (cost prohibitive - sample instead)

props.eval_dimensions: Which quality dimensions to measure: correctness, safety, relevance
props.judge_model: Model used for automated LLM-as-judge evaluation

pat.d: Use a strong LLM to evaluate outputs of the target model against rubrics, providing scalable automated quality scoring.
Run new model version in parallel with production, evaluate outputs without serving them, compare before promotion.

pits: LLM-as-judge bias - judge models have their own blind spots, calibrate with human evaluations
Overfitting to evaluation benchmarks while production quality degrades
Evaluation staleness - test sets need regular refresh as data distribution shifts
tips: Start with 3 key metrics: faithfulness, relevance, and refusal accuracy - add others incrementally
Maintain a golden test set that never changes for regression detection
Use sampling, not full evaluation, to keep costs manageable in production
